spec.text: Image 1 is the couple in their registration-day outfits; image 2 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Sunset on the Yonghe river levee path: seen from behind, the couple in their registration-day outfits walk hand in hand toward the setting sun, golden backlight and long shadows; across the river the Taipei skyline with Taipei 101. Every character must be rendered as a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, with faces, glasses, hairstyles and outfits identical to their references, never as a flat 2D drawing. Mouths closed in small gentle smiles. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
